blurb.text: A state whose quality wine comes mostly from five AVAs: Fennville, Lake Michigan Shore, Leelanau Peninsula, Old Mission Peninsula and Tip of the Mitt. Riesling is the most planted grape, ahead of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. It is also a leader in fruit wines such as cherry.
